cohort: 51 children diagnosed with CMPA by oral challenge and 31 controls
finding: An anamnesis-based questionnaire with a cut-off score of 7 had high sensitivity (94.4%) and specificity (96.9%) for distinguishing children with CMPA from controls.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean delivery was more common in children with cow's milk protein allergy compared to controls.
